content: The settings file is named prefs.js. The usual cause is being interrupted during shutdown by either an antivirus or VPN. Sometimes the file is read-only, in which case it's easy to fix. If you look in profile and see multiple prefs files, such as prefs-1.js, prefs-2.js, etc. that is further indication that thunderbird fails when shutting down. Although not a permanent fix, you can often restore the desired setting by removing all prefs files except the one with highest number, and renaming it to prefs.js. Repairing the cause is trial-and-error, again, usually an antivirus or VPN setting. That's all I know.

content: The choice depends on you. The ESR (140) is generally more stable because it receives fewer updates throuout the year, but the release level (152) provides new features throughout the year.
